property.statement: For each normalized observation input, the reader creates a unique run-root copy, verifies the copied bytes against the source SHA before yielding, and streams/falls back/restarts only from that verified copy; a persistent raw-path change still fails before D2 returns new panel ArtifactRecords.
runtime_path: _iter_observation_metric_frames creates a unique tempfile copy, compares sha256_file(copy) with the initial source digest, and delegates all PyArrow, pandas fallback, and restart reads to _iter_observation_metric_frames_from_snapshot
build_d2_stage writes temporary metric shards and only materializes monthly/annual Parquet and ArtifactRecord after the source iterator is fully exhausted
build_d2_stage StageBuildResult outputs feed the calibration-bundle copy plan in builders/release.py; changed-input D2 negative asserts this invocation returns no monthly/annual panel artifacts
property.proxy_divergence: Within the declared single-normalized-input property, the implementation reads an actual per-run byte copy verified by content SHA, not a size/mtime or endpoint-only proxy. The real pyarrow ParquetFile ABA test confirms it opens a path distinct from the source, rewrites the source between record batches, restores the source before EOF, and asserts all emitted metric values equal the frozen original rows. A same-size, same-mtime byte mutation before copy is rejected by SHA. This does not claim an atomic generation spanning multiple independent source files.
negative_controls: test_successful_stream_rejects_a_changed_input_snapshot: persistent no-error rewrite between batches fails closed
test_real_parquet_reader_uses_frozen_bytes_during_source_aba: real Parquet reader returns only original rows when the raw path changes and is restored mid-stream
test_snapshot_copy_detects_same_size_mtime_content_change: same-length content mutation with restored mtime is rejected before any reader yields
test_d2_does_not_materialize_panels_after_persistent_source_change: D2 failure returns no new monthly/annual panel artifacts
test_partial_resume_aborts_when_normalized_snapshot_changes: changed source during failed partial read is rejected
test_canonical_period_owner_uses_inclusive_calendar_bounds and test_period_owner_rejects_unknown_periods_without_2025_fallback: calendar bounds and invalid-period negative
test_build_d2_materializes_unique_observation_shards_and_counts: final panel ArtifactRecord digest is read back from output bytes
